main_text.l: stra hæc opella, næ caussa[?] non
enim ille olim de Platone, id
ego non minori iure nunc de te,
Nam & is es tu, in quo uno cū-

page.notes: The signature mark "ā 5" is partly worn; the 5 is uncertain. "cauffa" is read as "caussa" (long s doubled), marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "Reipu." is kept as printed, with its full stop. Ends mid-sentence; the text continues on the next page.
